newsitem.title: JAPAN: All months Tokyo corn futures close limit-down.
newsitem.headline: All months Tokyo corn futures close limit-down.

text.p: All months of Tokyo corn futures closed the daily 500 yen limit-down on Tuesday, on heavy selling following price falls on the Chicago market during the long weekend in Japan, traders said.
Benchmark September was down 500 yen at 16,400 yen per tonne. Daily volume was 106,705 lots.

A forecast for warmer-than-normal weather in the U.S. Midwest triggered selling on the CBOT corn market overnight, the traders said. Active long-liquidation from local investors, holding many longs, hit the Tokyo market from the opening session, they said.
The spot September contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $3.58 per bushel at 0830 GMT, against $3.57 at Monday's close.
The spot September of the CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $8.18 at 0830 GMT, against $8.14-1/2 from Monday's close.
